# settings

**In one sentence:** the Settings dialog for machine-wide options (Hugging Face cache, hardware, SeedVR2 folders, default models for new projects).

## Why it exists
Some options belong to the computer, not to a project: where models are cached, which GPU to use, where SeedVR2 lives. They are saved in `~/.prepare_lora_kit/settings.yaml` (see `docs/settings.md`) through the bridge, and any project YAML can still override them.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `controller.js` | `bindSettingsEvents()` hooks the Settings buttons in the library and project app bars (`openSettings`, `openSettingsShell`); missing buttons are ignored. |
| `settings.js` | `openSettingsModal()` — fetches `get_settings`, shows the form, wires Browse, copy-login-command, "check Hugging Face login", "check model access", "detect hardware", and Save (`save_settings`). |
| `form.js` | `buildSettingsModal(payload)` builds the three sections (Hugging Face, Hardware, Defaults for new projects); `applySettings` / `collectSettings` move values in and out of the form. |
| `fields.js` | Field builders: `selectField`, `modelField` (a dropdown with a "custom" free-text box), `textField` (optional Browse button), plus `readField` / `writeField` / `wireModelFields`. |
| `settings.css` | Styles for the settings modal, sections, help text, and access-check results. |

## How it works
- Each empty field shows the app default as placeholder text, so blank means "use the default".
- Save sends the collected values; errors are shown inline using `cleanError`.
- The Hugging Face token is never stored here; the dialog only shows a login command (from the bridge's `login_command`) to run in a terminal, then checks login status.

## Who uses it
- `core/app.js` calls `bindSettingsEvents()` at start-up.
- Bridge methods: `get_settings`, `save_settings`, `choose_folder`, `hf_status`, `check_model_access`, `detect_hardware`.
- Tests: `tests/ui/static/settings.test.js`.

## Good to know
- It is not a pipeline pause, so it never uses `modalCancelButton` (which would cancel a run).
